newsitem.title: USA: CITGO Petroleum Q1 net off, refining margins cited.
newsitem.headline: CITGO Petroleum Q1 net off, refining margins cited.

text.p: CITGO Petroleum Corp, which refines, transports and markets transportation fuels, lubricants, and petrochemicals, said Tuesday its 1997 first quarter net income fell to $12.8 million from $14.8 million in the same period a year ago due to poor refining margins.
Revenues for the first quarter increased to $3.3 billion from $2.6 billion in the 1996 first quarter, the company said in a statement.
Income from operations for the 1997 first quarter rose to $50.5 million from $49.2 million a year ago, it said.
CITGO is owned by PDV America Inc, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Petroleos de Venezuela S.A, the national oil company of Venezuela.
